numbers_inbound_needs_tenant.name: numbers_inbound_needs_tenant
numbers_inbound_needs_tenant.value: "numbers"."inbound_profile_id" is null or "numbers"."tenant_id" is not null

scripts_approved_requires_validation.name: scripts_approved_requires_validation
scripts_approved_requires_validation.value: "scripts"."status" <> 'approved' or ("scripts"."approved_at" is not null and "scripts"."disclosure_validated_at" is not null)

call_attempts_media_retention_idx.name: call_attempts_media_retention_idx
call_attempts_media_retention_idx.where: "call_attempts"."media_purged_at" is null and ("call_attempts"."recording_uri" is not null or "call_attempts"."transcript_uri" is not null)

call_attempts_party_known.name: call_attempts_party_known
call_attempts_party_known.value: ("call_attempts"."direction" = 'outbound' and "call_attempts"."contact_id" is not null and "call_attempts"."phone_hash" is not null) or ("call_attempts"."direction" = 'inbound' and ("call_attempts"."phone_hash" is not null or "call_attempts"."caller_withheld"))

qa_reviews_done_has_review.name: qa_reviews_done_has_review
qa_reviews_done_has_review.value: "qa_reviews"."status" <> 'done' or ("qa_reviews"."reviewed_at" is not null and "qa_reviews"."reviewer" is not null and "qa_reviews"."scores" is not null)

appointments_reminder_idx.name: appointments_reminder_idx
appointments_reminder_idx.where: status in ('scheduled','rescheduled') and intent_id is null and erased_at is null
